تقتلعين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَلِعِينَ (taqtaliʕīna) /taq.ta.li.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# تُقْتَلَعِينَ (tuqtalaʕīna) /tuq.ta.la.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
